lede: One command reads every file a glob matches & writes a single output, in a stable order.

features.title: Stable order
features.body: Matches are sorted before joining, so the same inputs always produce the same output.

features.title: One action
features.body: A single command with a few flags. Install & usage fit on this page.

features.title: Scriptable
features.body: Exit codes & output paths are predictable, which keeps build scripts short.
